title: You Shrink Every Single Day (Here's Why)

scenes.text: You are taller right now than you'll be tonight.
Every morning you wake up about one centimeter taller than when you went to bed.
The discs between the bones of your spine are soft and full of water.
All day, gravity squeezes them, and you slowly shrink.
At night, lying down, they soak up water again and you grow back.
Astronauts take this to the extreme. With no gravity, they come home up to five centimeters taller.

description:
The discs in your spine get squeezed by gravity all day, so you lose about a centimeter by night and get it back while you sleep.
Astronauts can return from space up to 5 cm taller.
Would you take the extra height?
